name: ETF Positioning page -- render DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE in the existing Positioning shape, with a Models<->ETFs toggle
description: Andrew-direct 2026-08-20 ~22:0xZ at the CTO~A terminal. Premise, his words: the ETF view 'will fold in exactly on top of the existing Positioning page. Simply instead of displaying the Models, we display the ETFs and their characteristics/holdings/etc. There is virtually no frontend work here involved aside from a clever toggle somewhere to flip between Models and ETFs. The real work will be procuring the data to be able to deliver that same shape.' Four commissioned steps: (1) find AJ's (CFO) daily US Bank email + download/assess attachments; (2) assess what the providers already give us in opal-data-etfs -- expected to yield 'proper weighted holdings on that basis for the Tree Chart' and the 'Holdings Breakdown' panel, with the UST/ST/INT/LT/ULT toggle bars swapped for DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE; (3) run atom-decomp on the Positioning page to pin the EXACT feeding data shape; (4) everything unfillable becomes a Bloomberg deliverable routed MSTR -> MSTR~Z, with the pull script modeled on the /terminal-upload Bloomberg scripts. RESEARCH LANDED 2026-08-21 (all four steps). HEADLINE FINDING: the US Bank EagleSTAR 'ETF-Opal-Reports' feed that prompted this covers ONLY PFDE (216630) + PFOE (216631) -- its own Verifications workbook Fund List sheet states 'Grand Total : 2' -- i.e. exactly the two funds we ALREADY hold holdings for; DIVZ/IDVZ appear in none of the four attachments (US Bank administers the Opal Capital trust; DIVZ/IDVZ sit on the TrueShares/Polen platform). So the new feed is a marginal gain (adds Investment Type Desc -> asset_class, and a coarse Domestic/Foreign geography axis) and does NOT close the gap. Andrew's weighted-holdings hypothesis CONFIRMED and exercised: silver/holdings already carries weight_pct, summing 99.99 (PFDE) / 99.98 (PFOE). The DIVZ/IDVZ holdings gap has two independent causes -- the deployed TS_HOLDINGS_ENABLED no-op (D4 finding) and the structural trust boundary -- and two independent remedies (issuer-side wiring vs Bloomberg pull) that must be priced against each other before either is built. Frontend correction: the model list is NOT a single constant -- 'UST' is hardcoded across 5 files under portal/src/pages/Positioning/, so the 'clever toggle' needs those unified into one book-set source first. Also found: the Positioning README is materially drifted from the served artifact (claims 35KB vs 8,150 B gzip / 73,487 B decompressed; documents a components/ dir, DurationTab and AttributionTab that do not exist; describes only one of the two live holdings forms).

phase: PHASE 0 -- RESEARCH LANDED, BUILD NOT AUTHORIZED. All four commissioned research steps complete and grounded (desired/applied/exercised recorded in PRD s.8). OPEN AT ANDREW (sovereign, sequencing-blocking): (a) the SCOPE CALL -- ship two full books (PFDE/PFOE) plus two fund-level-only shells (DIVZ/IDVZ), or hold the page until DIVZ/IDVZ constituents exist; (b) whether to route the Bloomberg ask now or first adjudicate the cheaper issuer-side TS_HOLDINGS_ENABLED wiring, since both close the same gap. NOT BLOCKED ON ANY AGENT. Non-blocking work that could proceed on his word: unify the 5 hardcoded model-list sites into one book-set source; run the Rule-24 four-postulate test on the ETF sub_asset_class vocabulary (a stock's sector is a different GRAIN from a model holding's duration bucket -- reusing the model vocabulary would put two grains on one axis).
blocking: Sequencing rests on two Andrew calls (scope: 2-full-plus-2-shell vs hold; and route: Bloomberg pull vs issuer-side wiring first). Neither is agent-resolvable. The project's technical hinge is a single untested question -- does Bloomberg serve constituent holdings for DIVZ/IDVZ -- which is P1 of the Bloomberg ask and is answerable in one terminal session by MSTR~Z. A NO there re-prices the whole project onto the issuer-side wiring route. No gate is implemented on this project; nothing is held.
